name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
about: Bharti Airtel Ltd is one of the world’s leading providers of telecommunication services with presence in 18 countries representing India, Sri Lanka, 14 countries in Africa.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: We are only at about 10 % to 12% share and for a Company of our size , we are not satisfied with that kind of presence , so we really need to step up our game in data centers and our ambition is to get to a gigawatt as we mentioned in a few years ’ time but that game will not end there , we will continue to build out and the data cent er market has 50% to 60% of its demand coming out of Mumbai , so land will need to be acquired and data centers will need to be built.
items.actual: Land bought for it in Q2 FY27
items.why: Too early to grade; in Q2 it bought a Rs 2,900 crore land parcel for this capacity.
items.actual_quote: In addition, we invested about 2,900 Crores in a strategic land parcel to pursue our one-gigawatt data center capacity ambition.

guidance.note: Airtel does not give numeric revenue, margin or capex guidance, so there is little to grade.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 16% a year over 5 years
Profit grew faster than sales (40.1% vs 16% a year), so margins widened
EBITDA margin up 3.3 pts in two years to 55.2%

items.said: Revenue up 4% on the last quarter
items.quote: Consolidated revenue came in at about Rs.60,900 Crores, growing 4% sequentially.
Consolidated revenue came in at about Rs.60,900 Crores, growing 4% sequentially.

items.said: Revenue up 5.7% on the last quarter
items.quote: Our consolidated revenue was Rs.58,500 Crores, growing at about 5.7% sequentially.
Our consolidated revenue was Rs.58,500 Crores, growing at about 5.7% sequentially.

claims.summary: All 4 company-wide figures management read out on the last 2 calls match the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 375% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 14 days to pay, against 10 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was -0% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit fell 10% while operating profit grew 37%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 31%, against 24% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 1.26× equity, against 1.88× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 50.1%, down 0.2 points over the last 4 reported quarters.
